MessageTypes.label: TRANSPONDER CODE
MessageTypes.description: Squawk sync. Digits 0..7 are right-aligned and zero-filled to 4 digits.

MessageTypes.label: FLIGHT ID
MessageTypes.description: Display-only callsign or flight ID, trimmed to 8 characters.

MessageTypes.label: REPLY INDICATOR
MessageTypes.description: Strict boolean: 0 hides the reply box, 1 shows it.

MessageTypes.label: SIM ON GROUND
MessageTypes.description: Strict boolean driving the automatic flight and trip timers.

MessageTypes.label: DISPLAY BACKLIGHT PWM
MessageTypes.description: External display backlight control, 0..255. The local backlight offset is applied afterwards.

MessageTypes.label: DISPLAY OLED CONTRAST
MessageTypes.description: External OLED contrast control, 0..100. The local contrast offset is applied afterwards.
